On September 2-12, 2026, three students of the Police Science program – Sergeant Natalia Kajdana and Sergeant Paweł Ryba and post. Tomasz Samoraj – completed a student internship in the Croatian Police in the city of Rijeka. They had the opportunity to learn about the functioning of the local formations responsible for security and to serve side by side with Croatian officers.

A group of 5 students from the Police Academy in Szczytno completed an intensive two-week Erasmus+ internship in Hungary, organized by Ludovika University of Public Service (LUPS) in cooperation with Hungarian Police (BRFK). The trip’s program combined theoretical classes, specialized workshops, and field service.

external_collaboration.partner_name: Jefatura Superior de Policia de Cataluña
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Five students and three graduates of the “Police Science” program at the Police Academy in Szczytno took part in a foreign Erasmus+ internship from June 28 to July 10, 2026, organized by the Jefatura Superior de Policia de Cataluña at the Complex Policial La Verneda in Barcelona. During the exchange, the officers had the opportunity to learn about the process of creating identity documents, handling cases related to human trafficking, and experienced the daily work of Spanish Policia Nacional.
From June 29 to July 2, 2026, the Police Academy in Szczytno hosted 10 representatives along with a supervisor from the Saxony Police University in Rothenburg (Germany).
